The company plans to issue fresh equity shares to raise substantial capital.  Proceeds will primarily be used to repay outstanding borrowings of its subsidiary.  This public offering marks Reliance group's first since 2008.

title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday

title: U.S. consumers grow more uneasy about jobs & finances as high inflation outlook holds steady, NY Fed finds
description: US consumers grew more pessimistic about jobs and personal finances in August. Inflation expectations remained largely unchanged, showing little relief for households. Consumers raised unemployment rate expectations to the highest level since April 2020. Their confidence in finding new jobs after a loss also weakened. This outlook faces the Federal Reserve's upcoming policy meeting.

title: Why US stocks are falling today: Dow Jones crashes 600 points on Trump threat to intensify US-Canada trade war amid oil price rise
description: Dow Jones dropped significantly as US President Donald Trump threatened Bombardier's market access. This escalation followed Canada's refusal to certify American Gulfstream jets, sparking counter tariffs. Brent crude futures rose above ninety-seven dollars a barrel after Houthi attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure. Higher energy prices are increasing inflation concerns ahead of the Fed's interest rate decision. European and Japanese central banks are expected to raise their interest rates soon.

title: Market trading guide: Data Patterns among four stock recommendations for Wednesday
description: Nifty extended losses for a second session, closing 144 points lower at 23,625. Analysts remain bearish as the index trades below key moving averages.
